posts.author: matsnil
posts.text: · Det skjer så mye i Gulfen og omegn at jeg ikke har mulighet til å rapportere alt. Qatar kom med en melding fra USA, men Iran sa blankt nei. Senere kom IRAN HAS JUST ANNOUNCED ITS LATEST DEMANDS TO GET ANY KIND OF PEACE NEGOTIATIONS WITH THE U.S. - $300 billion in U.S. compensation - Complete lifting of all U.S. sanctions - Release of $100 billion in frozen Iranian assets  - End of the U.S. naval blockade  - US troop withdrawal from the entire region - A comprehensive regional ceasefire including in Lebanon and Gaza. Altså ingen lettelser for "terrorstaten" USA
